replies.author: StewieFG
replies.body:
I would tell you something i wanted as a secret, but after you said that i have to tell you.
In the middle, the chest have 4 "sheers of destiny" with Knockback II, and the map has a lot of void. Another, you have some chests hidden all around the map, i just didnt show on screenshots.
So the gameplay will be more fun than other maps, I wanted to do it TDM, Then we added 4 monuments and turned that to DTM.
Of course we have the option to make is TDM Backm but first i want to see other players feedback.
Thanks for the feedback!
